# Backend address pool

Manages one pool, explicit IP or regional-frontend backend addresses, and Gateway tunnel interfaces.
The caller owns cardinality. NIC membership belongs to the NIC-owning module.
Set `backend_address_type = "NIC"` to omit the server-maintained address
projection; native NIC references are never authored here. IP/Frontend member
lists are authoritative, including `[]` for last-member removal. Frontend mode
requires the caller to declare `sku_tier = "Global"` matching the actual parent.
Each frontend member supplies `properties.loadBalancerFrontendIPConfiguration.id`
instead of `properties.ipAddress`, with no VNet. IDs must reference public
Standard regional LB frontends of a compatible IP family; this module validates
the ARM type, not the remote resource's configuration.

One destroy-only action clears the explicit list before pool deletion or rename,
required for Global frontend-reference pools. It stores a fixed empty list,
not a NIC snapshot, and is not the refreshing resource owner. It shares retry,
timeouts and the parent mutex. AzAPI 2.13 does not support ignore\_body\_changes
on actions, and its destroy action uses the create timeout for the request.
Exact-candidate automatic lifecycle and migration remain subject to live proof.

This standalone module is for externally managed LBs only; see
`examples/child-resources`. The root does not call it and always owns the entire
pool collection. Never use both owners on the same LB, even for different keys.
The LB owner must preserve `properties.backendAddressPools` on every parent
update. Do not combine this module with authoritative inline ownership of the
same collection. The shared parent-ID mutex serializes child PUT/DELETE calls
within one provider process, not across Terraform states or external writers.

For adoption only, `avm_managed_migration_enabled` imports the existing named
pool into `azapi_resource.this` using this child's selected API version. The
standalone caller sets that flag. Disable it after convergence; never use it for a new pool.

## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_location"></a> [location](#input\_location)

Description: The Azure region for this module's resources or telemetry deployment.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_name"></a> [name](#input\_name)

Description: The backend address pool name.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_parent_id"></a> [parent\_id](#input\_parent\_id)

Description: The parent load balancer resource ID.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_properties"></a> [properties](#input\_properties)

Description: Writable pool ARM properties: virtualNetwork ID object, tunnelInterfaces (identifier/port/protocol/type), and authoritative loadBalancerBackendAddresses. Each member has name and properties containing exactly one of ipAddress (optional virtualNetwork ID object) or loadBalancerFrontendIPConfiguration ID object. Frontend members require Global tier/Frontend mode and no VNet. NIC mode requires an empty input list and omits the server projection; NIC ownership remains external.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    virtualNetwork = optional(object({ id = string }))
    tunnelInterfaces = optional(list(object({
      identifier = number
      port       = number
      protocol   = string
      type       = string
    })), [])
    loadBalancerBackendAddresses = optional(list(object({
      name = string
      properties = object({
        ipAddress                           = optional(string)
        virtualNetwork                      = optional(object({ id = string }))
        loadBalancerFrontendIPConfiguration = optional(object({ id = string }))
      })
    })), [])
  })
```

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_avm_managed_migration_enabled"></a> [avm\_managed\_migration\_enabled](#input\_avm\_managed\_migration\_enabled)

Description: Import an existing pool at parent\_id/backendAddressPools/name without deleting it. Enable only for adoption, never fresh creation; disable after convergence.

Type: `bool`

Default: `false`

### <a name="input_backend_address_type"></a> [backend\_address\_type](#input\_backend\_address\_type)

Description: IP (default) or Frontend owns an explicit list with fixed-empty destroy cleanup; NIC omits the projection and leaves memberships to the NIC owner. Clear explicit members before changing to NIC, and detach NICs before changing from NIC.

Type: `string`

Default: `"IP"`

### <a name="input_enable_telemetry"></a> [enable\_telemetry](#input\_enable\_telemetry)

Description: This variable controls whether or not telemetry is enabled for the module.  
For more information see <https://aka.ms/avm/telemetryinfo>.  
If it is set to false, then no telemetry will be collected.

Type: `bool`

Default: `true`

### <a name="input_ignore_body_changes"></a> [ignore\_body\_changes](#input\_ignore\_body\_changes)

Description: Body-relative dot paths. `network_load_balancers_backend_address_pools` contains pool paths to ignore. NIC references are omitted from writes; live membership preservation requires real-Azure verification. Ignored configuration is not sent to Azure; changes take effect after apply.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    network_load_balancers_backend_address_pools = optional(list(string), [])
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_resource_types"></a> [resource\_types](#input\_resource\_types)

Description: Resource API versions. `network_load_balancers_backend_address_pools` is the backend pool ARM resource type and API version.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    network_load_balancers_backend_address_pools = optional(string, "Microsoft.Network/loadBalancers/backendAddressPools@2025-01-01")
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_retry"></a> [retry](#input\_retry)

Description: Resource retry controls: error\_message\_regex, interval\_seconds and max\_interval\_seconds.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    error_message_regex  = optional(list(string))
    interval_seconds     = optional(number)
    max_interval_seconds = optional(number)
  })
```

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_sku_tier"></a> [sku\_tier](#input\_sku\_tier)

Description: Declaration of the externally owned parent LB tier, Regional or Global. The caller must match its actual SKU and use public Standard regional frontend IDs for Global members; this module does not inspect remote parents.

Type: `string`

Default: `"Regional"`

### <a name="input_timeouts"></a> [timeouts](#input\_timeouts)

Description: Per-operation create, read, update and delete timeouts as Go duration strings.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    create = optional(string)
    read   = optional(string)
    update = optional(string)
    delete = optional(string)
  })
```
